newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cypriot president in hospital for heart tests.
newsitem.headline: Cypriot president in hospital for heart tests.

text.p: Cypriot President Glafcos Clerides was admitted to hospital on Tuesday morning for medical tests after complaining of minor chest pain, his spokesman said.
Clerides, 78, was admitted to the Nicosia General Hospital at 06.00 a.m. local (0300 GMT) and is due to be released from hospital later on Tuesday, spokesman Manolis Christofides said.
"The results of the tests are considered satisfactory," a medical report signed by four doctors said.
Christofides said Clerides's admission to hospital for tests on Tuesday morning was decided by his doctors on Monday evening after feeling chest twinges for a period of two days.
His doctors have recommended a week's rest but Christofides told journalists the president will continue his official appointments and return to his duties on Wednesday.
However an official visit to China scheduled for next week has been postponed, Christofides said.
Clerides is due to meet United Nations Under Secretary-General Sir Kieran Prendergast on Wednesday.
